_doc: Pass boundaries of the watch daemons, as data (PROP-010 section 2). Nothing here is code: the wrapper only reads these patterns, so a change in the upstream output is a change to this file and never to a module. Every entry of channels is one daemon: script is the npm script of the fork tree that starts it; passStart / passEnd / errorLine / errorCountLine / falseEndGuards are JavaScript regular-expression sources, matched (unanchored .test) against a single log line after ANSI escapes have been stripped. passStart opens a pass and passEnd closes it; a line that matches falseEndGuards never closes a pass, even when it also matches passEnd. errorLine parses one diagnostic: capture group 1 is the file, numeric groups 2 and 3 are line and column when present, a group of the form TSnnnn is the diagnostic code and the last group is the message. errorCountLine carries the authoritative number of errors of the pass in group 1 and wins over the number of parsed errorLine matches - the typecheck channel needs it because the counter in its own passEnd line is a flag (0 or 1), not a count.

transpile._doc: The only writer of out/, and it empties out/ when it starts: never restart a living transpile daemon (PROP-010 section 2).

typecheck._doc: noEmit type check plus code generation into src/. Real watch-client lines carry a [HH:mm:ss] prefix while the generated fixtures stay bare, so every pattern accepts exactly that optional prefix. The generators print their own 'Finished compilation <id> with N errors after M ms' markers on every change; those look like the end of a pass and are not, so they are guarded. The guard tells them apart by what follows the word compilation: a non-empty id, never the literal 'with'.

extensions._doc: Forty extension projects; the per-pass total arrives on its own line, so errorCountLine is the source of the number and the tsc lines, when the daemon prints them, give the detail.

copilot._doc: esbuild plus a tsc noEmit pass; either of the two lines ends a pass, and the tsc summary also carries the count.
passEnd: Found (\d+) errors?\. Watching for file changes
errorCountLine: Found (\d+) errors?\. Watching for file changes
